## Testing

## Safety checklist

- [ ] Does not collect Technic credentials
- [ ] Does not collect cookies or session tokens
- [ ] Does not bypass login, 2FA, CAPTCHA, permissions, or anti-abuse systems
- [ ] Does not add broad host permissions unnecessarily
- [ ] Keeps visible user confirmation before submitting third-party forms
- [ ] Keeps manual fallback available where applicable
